excerpt.rendered: We connected customer and campaign data to identify audiences and activate more relevant marketing across brands.

case_study_builder.heading: Semler Group: Scaling local automotive marketing with Dolocal.io
Empowering local car dealerships through automation
case_study_builder.services_offered:
Paid media strategy
Campaign execution
Local Advertisement
case_study_builder.content_heading: Modern brands don’t need more campaigns they need systems that perform.
case_study_builder.short_text: Semler Group is Denmark’s largest automotive distributor, representing brands such as Volkswagen, ŠKODA, SEAT, Cupra, and Porsche. With hundreds of local dealerships across the country, the group plays a central role in shaping how Danes research, test, and purchase their vehicles.

case_study_builder.heading: Digital dealerships needed a new playbook
case_study_builder.content_heading: Semler needed a scalable way to reach online car shoppers.
case_study_builder.short_text: Semler needed a way for every dealership to launch targeted paid media without heavy manual work. The dolocal.io platform automated campaign creation and delivery, giving dealers a simple way to reach local buyers across display and social at scale. It bridged the gap between headquarters and local teams, ensuring consistent brand execution across all dealerships.
case_study_builder.review_text: Danish consumers are among the most digitised in Europe. 95% of all car buyers use digital channels throughout the buying process.

case_study_builder.heading: A changing buyer journey demanded a new digital solution
case_study_builder.short_text:
As Danish car buyers moved almost entirely online, Semler Group’s local dealerships were still relying on traditional, manual marketing methods. Without a scalable digital approach, dealers struggled to reach in-market buyers, launch consistent campaigns, and prove the impact of their media investments.

  • Digital shoppers weren’t being reached at key decision moments
  • Local dealers lacked the skills and tools for effective paid media
  • Manual campaign execution slowed time-to-market
  • Inconsistent marketing across brands diluted performance
case_study_builder.short_text_solution:
Together with Densou, Semler introduced an automated local advertising platform enabling dealerships to easily launch always-on, hyper-local campaigns across display and social channels. Campaign creation, targeting, and distribution were streamlined to help every dealer engage buyers where decisions now happen: online.

  • Automated campaign creation pulled directly from live inventory
  • Targeting optimized for local reach and conversion
  • 20,000+ local campaigns executed across the brand portfolio
  • Dealers reported higher traffic, engagement, and qualified leads

case_study_builder.heading: Shaping the future of automotive retail
case_study_builder.testimonial: The local platform has been adopted across all brands and supports our digital transformation process across marketing entities.
